item.title: Space is a warfighting domain. Our industrial base must reflect that.
item.description: When I served as acting Secretary of Defense, I took a trip to Buckley Space Force Base. I went as someone who understood in the abstract that space had become contested. I left understanding it in my gut. Watching the men and women who track every object on orbit and leverage space-based sensors to spot a launch anywhere on Earth to give our ground forces the seconds of warning that save lives, I came away with a conviction that has only deepened since: Space is a warfighting domain, and we are not yet organized to win in it.
